title: Count Digits
problemStatement: Given an integer n, return how many digits it has.
intuition: Each division by 10 peels one digit. Work is proportional to digit count = O(log10 n), not O(n).

approaches.title: Brute: convert to string
approaches.idea: len(str(abs(n))) — clear, but less “mathy” in interviews.
approaches.code:
def count_digits_str(n: int) -> int:
    return len(str(abs(n)))
limitations: Fine here; avoid building huge strings in hotter loops

approaches.title: Optimal: divide by 10

patternRecognition: Digit DP / digit peeling problems start here
followUps: Count digits in O(1) with logs? (careful with floats)
interviewInsight: They want O(1) aux and correct n=0 — tiny problems still expose carelessness.
